workLog.evidence: git push blocked: pre-push python-tests failed after 1047s. 16 of 17 gates passed.
Reproduced locally: 2 failed, 23578 passed in 986s. Both failures are pytest-timeout at 120s, not assertions.
Failures are not caused by the blocked branch: its diff is 6 files, all markdown and JSON, zero .py.
tests/test_no_duplicate_module_level_defs.py walks the repo root and its _SKIP set omits worktrees. tests/test_no_verify_prohibition.py walks .claude, which contains .claude/worktrees.
Measured 98769 .py files walked, 91986 of them (93 percent) inside nested worktrees. Documented scope is 819 files under tests/.

Issue #4160 fixed the identical bug in _python_sources; tests/ci/test_worktree_path_filter.py records that the skip must match parts relative to the walk root, or a repo living under a worktrees dir is skipped whole.
Scanned all 20 repo-root walkers in tests/. Every other one is scoped to a narrow subdir, so the affected set is exactly the two failing gates.
Added worktrees to _SKIP, switched both walkers to relative-parts matching, renamed the misleading _TESTS_ROOT to _REPO_ROOT, corrected the docstring that claimed the walk was scoped to tests/.

git ls-files shows exactly one tracked path containing worktrees (.agents/projects/v0.3.0/worktrees/.gitkeep) and zero tracked .py files, and .agents is not an instruction root, so coverage loss is zero.
Added tests/ci/test_walkers_skip_worktrees.py: 5 tests including two negative controls and the #4160 root-under-worktrees regression. All pass.
Walk drops from 98769 to 6783 files (93.1 percent). The two gates go from 2 failed in 292.99s to 20 passed in 75.83s, worst test 38.04s against a 120s timeout.
